dedupe_keys.name: mongolia environmental statistics database box forms land water use and quality forest biodiversity climate and air waste greenhouse gases

description: Mongolia's Environmental Information Centre keeps the national environmental statistics database, built from annual BOX report forms that reporting bodies enter online. The status table read on 2026-09-29 lists some 30 forms, most updated for 2025: land (unified land fund, land degradation and rehabilitation, rehabilitation of land disturbed by mining), water (resources and depletion, water use, water quality), forest (resources and use, degradation and restoration), biodiversity (use and protection of animals and plants, illegal trade), climate and air quality, waste (municipal solid waste: number and area of central disposal sites, tonnes transported, disposed, landfilled and burnt, fee revenue, and waste from ger districts, apartments and streets; hazardous waste; recycling and reuse), and greenhouse gases. The home page quotes national totals for 2025, such as 656,820.74 thousand m³ of water used. Coverage: national, with filters by area. Format and access: web tables in Mongolian with filters, and blank forms to download; free to read, data entry needs a login. Licence: not stated. Caveats: figures are reported by agencies and aimags and are not audited on the page; some forms lag a year. Simulation uses: waste and water service planning and climate adaptation scenarios. Related records: complements the NAMEM weather, water and environment data (data-namem-mongolia-weather-water-environment).
